title: PARENT’S GUIDE TO CHALLENGING BEHAVIORS

description_full: PARENT’S GUIDE TO CHALLENGING BEHAVIORS Thursday, November 19, 2026 1:00 p.m. Virtual Event Discover a proven, research-based approach to better understand your child’s behavior and what influences it. Learn practical tools to prevent challenging behaviors—and handle them calmly when they do occur. Ask questions, gain ready-to-use strategies and leave feeling more confident in your parenting. For parents of children ages 2–8. Visit registration page. Although this event is not specifically for families of children with a developmental delay or disability, the information may be useful. Sponsored by the Howard County Office of Children and Families. Free

description_full: PARENT CAFE Thursday, November 19, 2026 6:00-8:00 p.m. Dinner served 6:00-6:30 Cafe conversation will begin at 6:30 pm Linden Hall 4765 Dorsey Hall Rd. Ellicott City, MD 21042 Parents of children birth-5 with an IFSP or IEP will come together to talk about ways to take care of themselves, develop strong relationships with their children, and strengthen their families. Dinner and childcare are provided! Bring the kids in PJ’s if you like. Please contact EISFamily@hcpss.org with questions. Visit registration page This event is sponsored by HCPSS and aligns with the question about the school or school system offering training about special education issues and being connected with other families for mutual support on the MDSE parent survey that is sent to families of students with an IEP or IFSP annually. Free
